study: Frozen HMM decision-value and Russell 3000 proxy study
training_selection: Preserve the original zero-interest expert calibration. HMM and normalization fit only before validation; each state takes the expert with the largest positive training HAC lower bound satisfying existing evidence minima. All-cash outcomes are retained. No validation or evaluation return can change configuration, offsets, or policy.
reference: Reproduce the existing winner using training 2018-2022 after a shared 100-session warmup. Treat 2023-2025 and 2026 through October 8 as previously observed research checks, not pristine holdouts.
rolling: For evaluation year Y, train the fixed configuration on Y-4 through Y-2, record Y-1 validation without selection, and evaluate Y. Regime labels are fitted anew and interpreted only through each training library. Annual evaluation books start cash and liquidate at the last available open within that year; omitted cross-year gaps are disclosed.
ablation: Ungated momentum uses the identical 20-session signal, 100-session trend check, dates, equal stock cash slots, costs and schedule, removing both HMM state gating and posterior confidence sizing jointly. A confidence-sized ungated momentum control retains maximum-state posterior sizing on every state, removing only state eligibility and minimum-confidence gates. A momentum-only HMM policy is additionally fit on training when full-library policies choose mean reversion, so attribution does not conflate expert changes.
benchmarks: IWV adjusted OHLC is a dividend-adjusted Russell 3000 ETF proxy, not the official Russell 3000 index. ETF fund expenses are already embedded and are not charged again. Equal-initial-weight stock and IWV passive books pay matching modeled entry/exit execution fees. Cash yield uses FRED DGS3MO 3-month investment-basis annual yields, forward-filled using only prior observations then lagged two actual stock sessions before simulation, approximated with simple ACT/365 interest on unencumbered cash. Also report zero-interest strategies.
exposure_controls: Constant passive allocations use average training HMM gross exposure only, held fixed before scoring; this is ex ante allocation matching, not exact realized risk matching. A second IWV control executes the HMM's contemporaneously available gross target on the same rebalance dates to separate market timing from stock selection without using future exposure.
offsets: Evaluate every offset 0 through 19 with frozen offset-zero fitted policies and compare to same-offset ungated momentum. Never select the best offset. Initial cash persists until the first offset rebalance.
decision_audit: For every scheduled rebalance and momentum-eligible stock, show HMM allowed or blocked status plus the subsequent same-schedule gross and hypothetical roundtrip net holding return. These are descriptive counterfactuals on decisions fixed before the holding return; correlated stocks and dates are not independent trials.
uncertainty: Joint-date 20-session circular moving-block bootstrap, 2000 resamples, fixed seed; descriptive 95% intervals on paired cumulative-return differences. Intervals do not correct research reuse, model fitting uncertainty, calendar choice or multiple comparisons.
breadth: After the three-stock study, evaluate the supplied current 100-stock list as a separate momentum-only HMM allocation hypothesis, training 2018-2022 and evaluating 2023-2025 and 2026 without changing rules. Do not fit a 100-variable 60-row cointegration expert. Reuse is explicit; survivor and user-list selection bias remain. Report all missing symbols and calendar losses, without silent substitution.
decision_criteria: Continue HMM only if paired after-cost evidence and drawdown protection repeat across chronological periods and rebalance offsets. Prefer the simpler momentum rule if it matches or exceeds the HMM without a consistent risk benefit. Concentration, sparse trades or nonpositive bootstrap lower bounds count as insufficient evidence; no profitability guarantee or forced positive outcome.
prospective: A future paper-trading evaluation must be registered after this study, using subsequently arriving sessions and frozen rules. No historical result in this study is called a pristine unseen holdout.
